title: 06. Memory, State & HITL: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)
summary: Some agent actions are too important, too risky, or too irreversible to execute autonomously. Human-in-the-Loop adds checkpoints where a human must review and approve before the agent proceeds.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > Some agent actions are too important, too risky, or too irreversible to execute autonomously. Human-in-the-Loop adds **checkpoints** where a human must **review and approve** before the agent proceeds.

sections.title: HITL Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP — WHEN AND HOW                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  WHEN TO REQUIRE HUMAN APPROVAL:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ┌─────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Action Type            │  Risk Level → HITL?             │
  ├─────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────┤
  │  Read-only operations   │  Low       → No HITL needed      │
  │  Write to local files   │  Medium    → Log only            │
  │  Send email/message     │  Medium    → Confirm first       │
  │  Database write         │  High      → Show preview + OK  │
  │  Financial transaction  │  Very High → Require approval   │
  │  Delete data            │  Very High → Require approval   │
  │  Deploy to production   │  Critical  → Require approval   │
  │  External API calls     │  Depends   → Log + optional OK  │
  └─────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┘

  HITL MODES:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  MODE 1: APPROVE/REJECT
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Agent proposes action → Human approves or rejects.

  Agent:  "I plan to send this email to 5,432 customers:
           Subject: [Summer Sale]
           Body: [email content]
           ⚠️  This will send 5,432 emails. Approve? (Y/N)"
  Human:  "Y"
  Agent:  ✅ Sends email

  MODE 2: EDIT + APPROVE
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Agent proposes action → Human can edit then approve.
  Best for: content generation, emails, reports.

  Agent:  "Draft generated. Edit if needed, then approve:"
  Human:  [edits subject line] → "Approve"
  Agent:  ✅ Sends edited version

  MODE 3: STEP-BY-STEP APPROVAL
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Every single agent step requires approval.
  Best for: high-stakes environments, initial deployment.

  Agent:  "Step 1: I will read the database schema. Approve?"
  Human:  "Yes"
  Agent:  [reads schema]
  Agent:  "Step 2: I will write this SQL query: SELECT... Approve?"
  Human:  "Yes"
  Agent:  [executes query]

  MODE 4: INTERRUPT + OVERRIDE
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Agent runs autonomously but human can interrupt at any time.
  Agent sends progress updates.
  Human can type "STOP" to pause immediately.

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  HITL DECISION FRAMEWORK:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

                    Can action be UNDONE?
                    ┌──── YES ────┐──── NO ────┐
                    ▼             ▼             ▼
             Reversible       Reversible    Irreversible
             + Low cost       + High cost   (always HITL)

             Log only         Show preview
             Auto proceed     + confirm
```
